{{Quote|The hull shows substantial scoring and wear. Whenever it crashed, it wasn't recently. General Plo, the scans check out. It's a T-6 shuttle, all right, serial number 775519.|[[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]]|<ref name="The Lost One">{{TCW|The Lost One}}</ref>}}
'''775519''' was a [[T-6 shuttle/Legends|T-6 shuttle]] used by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was shot down over the [[Oba Diah moon/Legends|desert moon of Oba Diah]], killing Sifo-Dyas, and its remains were later discovered by the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] of [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]] c. [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].
